findings: Reported 22.5 saved hours originates from a synthetic 1.5x multiplier in code rather than verified worklogs.
Actual logged activities in manual-service-activities.json total only 9.5 hours across 3 entries (236% inflation).
15 claimed analyst interventions cite static Runbook IDs ('RB-MDE-2026-08-01') instead of discrete execution records.
FTE capacity gain claims (~0.1 FTE) cannot be presented to customers without verified timesheet evidence.
riskList: RSK-01: Customer contract and SLA disputes over fabricated saved hours.
RSK-02: Runbooks cited as action proof, failing SOC 2 audit standards.
recommendations: Bind each intervention to an audited ActionId with PerformedAtUtc and TicketRef.
Eliminate the 1.5x multiplier and compute hours strictly from approved timesheets.
Suppress the FTE capacity card or display 0.0 with 'No Verified Timesheet' when hours are unverified.
